title: Page 9
content_zh:
阿丰皱眉。“是吗？可是在我们看来大嫂对老大你是真心的，再说就算刚开始是个错误，可是两个人交往久了总是会产生感情的嘛！老大你是不是太武断了？”是吗？
阿丰的话让他产生了些许的动摇，心底深处他想要相信阿丰。
“老大你再这样固执下去，小心以后后悔喔！”看到褚天阔的犹豫，阿丰语重心长的道。
楼下的徐士凯正搂着他最心爱的女人走向停车场。
不用阿丰说，他现在已经后悔了……
第9章(1)
她再也不曾来看过他。
小琦来的时候也没有再带过炖汤给他，他终于成功把她赶走了。
可是他却一点喜悦的心情都没有。
两个星期以后他出院，回到正常的生活轨道。
她也没有再来公司找过他。知道阿丰都会固定跟小兔咖啡屋订便当，他却拉不下脸来跟阿丰说他后悔了，给他也订一份。
本来就没有交集的两个人，如果一方刻意躲避或者不联络，久而久之，也就淡了，没有关系了。
不知道她跟士凯后来怎样。
可能发展的不错，所以她没空再来找他。
这个想法使他连续几天情绪都宛如火药库一样，手下们都躲着他。
几天后，阿丰交给他一个信封，说是“乔小姐”要他转交的。
阿丰的脸色不是太好看，最近这个小弟越来越没大没小，他也不去计较。接过信封的那一刻，他的手微微颤抖。
光是听到她的名字就让他这么激动，他想自己也许没有想像中豁达。
然而里面没有信，只有十万块的现钞。
“这是怎么回事？”

“乔小姐说要还你的钱。她说跟你借了那么多很过意不去，她会努力赚钱还你，不过请你给她一点时间。”
褚天阔蹙紧眉心。“我没要她还。”
“可是她坚持不想欠你。老大，我实在看不过去了啦！”阿丰好像忍了很久终于爆发。“你都不知道大嫂她现在为了赚钱每天过得多辛苦！她中午要做便当，晚上还出去摆摊子卖卤味，每天做到半夜一、两点，我都不知道她在赌什么气，再这样下去她一定会累倒的！”
“你说什么？”褚天阔揪住阿丰的领子。
阿丰快不能呼吸了，都忘了老大的力道有多大。“哎呀！反正你快去看看她啦！你们有什么问题就摊开来讲，老大你再这么恰下去，以后会后悔的啦！”
不用他说，褚天阔也忍不住了，他丢下阿丰，大步就往外走。
开着车子来到小兔咖啡屋，可是他不知道要用什么立场进去找她，只得一直坐在车上迟疑着，直到过了傍晚，他看到她推着一个小摊子出现。
瘦弱的身子要推动一个不算轻的摊子并不是件容易的事，但她却推过了好几条街，来到热闹的街区，而他也开着车偷偷跟在她身后。
附近有捷运站，也有KTV等娱乐中心，所以人潮还不算少。
褚天阔坐在车里，看着她叫卖。几天没见，她该死的又更瘦了一些，那苍白的脸色跟大大的眼睛底下的阴影，让他内心煎熬着心疼跟气愤。
他想知道这些日子以来她究竟是怎么过的，于是他隐忍下情绪，努力压抑下车去找她的冲动，继续坐在车里默默的守候着她。
时间一分一秒过去，人渐渐稀少了，最后连捷运都停驶了，她仍然没有离开。
十二点……一点……两点……
她坐在小椅子上，路灯下的影子显得分外瘦小，孤零零的。
没有客人的时候，她受不了疲惫，有时候会不小心闭上眼睛睡着，过没几秒又猛然惊醒，甩甩头，强打起精神。
然后没有几分钟，又再睡着……
他已经无法再忍耐下去了。她不爱他也好，她其实喜欢的是别的男人也罢，他都没有办法放着她不管。
下车，甩上车门，他大步向她走去。
他还没靠近她时，KTV里突然出来几个男人走近她的摊子围着她，她露出不安的表情。
“小姐，不用在这里卖卤味了啦！跟我们一起去唱歌，我们给你两千块怎样？比卖卤味好赚对不对？”

“不要！你们走开！”
一个男人抓住了她的手，她害怕的直哆嗦，拼命挣扎，却挣脱不了男人的手劲，她急得都快要哭出来了。
天阔！救我！
这时候她脑袋里只出现这个名字，可是她立刻又想到现在已经不能依靠他了。
他跟她已经没有关系了。
“走开！你们这些坏蛋！”
拔高的尖叫在深夜没发生什么效果，只徒增男人们的讪笑。
她又急又气，挣扎得更用力，可突然间，手上的压力消失了，刚刚还抓着她的男人不知怎么地就摔倒在地上。
砰、砰！肉体被拳头撞击的声音显得异常血腥。
她瞠目结舌的看着不知道何时出现的褚天阔把人给打倒在地上。
“滚！”他发出让人胆寒的低沉怒吼。
那几个男人用畏惧的眼光看着高大壮硕的他，拉起受伤的同伴，狼狈的转身逃走。
乔若曦不知道自己该怎么反应，直到褚天阔抓住她的手。
“跟我回去！”
“不、不要！”她回过神来，拼命的往后躲。
没想过她会拒绝的他皱紧眉头。“你说什么？”
她拒绝看他，转过头。“你不要管我，我还有生意要做。”
“做什么生意，现在都几点了？你一个女孩子在这里很危险你知不知道？”他气炸了。一想到她不知道过了多久这种日子，遇过多少次危险，他就快要疯掉。
“不关你的事。”她倔强的吐出这句话。
“什么？”

“我做什么都不关你的事了。”乔若曦终于转头直视他，恨恨的说：“我已经不是你的女朋友了，这点你不是表达的很清楚了吗？你还好心的把我介绍给别人不是吗？”
他错愕、愤怒，却无法反驳。她什么时候变得那么会说话了？温顺的小兔子什么时候开始会咬人了？
不是她变了，就是她真的被激怒了。而她看着他的眼睛里，有着他无法承受的怨愤。
“请你走开。”她甩开他的手，回到自己的小摊子。
褚天阔呆站着，第一次手足无措的不知如何是好。
他总算见识了她顽固起来可以多么坚持。已经是第五天了，她每天晚上都来摆摊，他也一直默默的开车跟着她，在街角守候着她。
深夜时分，她眼底的黑眼圈比前几日更深了，打盹的次数也变多了，那张小脸现在削瘦的两颊都凹陷下去。
他沉郁的眼锁在她身上，再这么下去她的身体会撑不下去的。他焦急、烦躁，可是却什么都不能做。
因为她拿他的话来堵他的嘴。要分手的人是他，他再也没有权利管她。
该死的！她这么顽固干什么？他无法理解她坚持要赚钱还他的动机是什么。他说了不用她还，可是她却不听。
今天晚上她的生意不太好，可能是因为下起毛毛细雨的关系，街上的人并不多。
她不知道第几次疲惫的睡着后，看看手表叹了口气，然后开始收拾起摊子。
褚天阔松了口气。她决定回家了，很好，今天比往常要早了一个小时。
每当看她拿起那沉重的保温箱的吃力摸样，他都很想冲下车去帮她。可是那只会换来她的拒绝跟怒视，之前他好几次想帮，但她根本不肯接受他的任何帮助。可恶的女人！
她推起摊车往回家的路上走。雨打在她身上，她没有穿雨衣，一下子就淋湿了，加上今天卖掉的东西不多，车子更重，她的身子摇摇晃晃，好像快要承受不住那重量似的。
content_en:
A Feng frowned. "Really? But it seems to us that sister-in-law is sincere to you, boss. Besides, even if it was a mistake at the beginning, two people will always develop feelings after being together for a long time! Boss, are you too arbitrary?" Really?
Afeng's words made him shake a little, and deep down in his heart, he wanted to believe Afeng.
"Boss, if you continue to be stubborn like this, you may regret it later!" Seeing Chu Tiankuo's hesitation, Afeng said seriously.
Downstairs, Xu Shikai was walking towards the parking lot with his most beloved woman in his arms.
Needless to say, Afeng already regrets it...
Chapter 9(1)
She never came to see him again.
Xiaoqi didn't bring him any more stew when she came, and he finally succeeded in driving her away.
But he felt no joy at all.
He was discharged from the hospital two weeks later and returned to his normal life.
She never came to the company to look for him again. Knowing that Feng always ordered lunch boxes from Little Rabbit Cafe, he couldn't help but tell Feng that he regretted it and order one for him too.
If two people who have never interacted with each other deliberately avoid or do not communicate with each other, over time they will fade away and have no relationship.
I don’t know what happened to her and Shikai.
Maybe it was going well, so she didn't have time to come see him again.
This thought made him feel like a gunpowder storehouse for several days, and his subordinates all avoided him.
A few days later, Afeng handed him an envelope and said that "Miss Qiao" asked him to deliver it.
Afeng's face is not very pretty. Recently, this little brother has become less and less old, so he doesn't care about it. The moment he took the envelope, his hands trembled slightly.
Just hearing her name made him so excited that he thought maybe he wasn't as open-minded as he thought.
However, there was no letter inside, only 100,000 yuan in cash.
"What's going on?"
"Miss Qiao said she wants to pay you back. She said she feels sorry for borrowing so much from you. She will work hard to make money to pay you back, but please give her some time."
Chu Tiankuo frowned. "I didn't ask her to pay it back."
"But she insists that she doesn't want to owe you. Boss, I really can't stand it!" Afeng seemed to have endured it for a long time and finally broke out. "You don't even know how hard my sister-in-law is working every day to make money! She makes bento at noon, and goes out to set up a stall to sell braised food at night. She does it until one or two o'clock in the middle of the night every day. I don't know what she is angry about. She will definitely collapse from exhaustion if she continues like this!"
"What did you say?" Chu Tiankuo grabbed Afeng's collar.
A Feng could hardly breathe and had forgotten how strong the boss was. "Oh! Anyway, go and see her! If you have any problems, just talk about it. Boss, if you continue to be like this, you will regret it in the future!"
Needless to say, Chu Tiankuo couldn't help it anymore. He left Afeng behind and strode out.
He drove to Little Rabbit Cafe, but he didn't know what position to take when he went in to find her, so he had to sit in the car and hesitate until after dusk, he saw her pushing a small stall.
It was not easy for a thin body to push a stall that was not very light, but she pushed it through several streets and arrived at the lively neighborhood, and he followed her secretly in his car.
There is an MRT station nearby, as well as KTV and other entertainment centers, so the crowds are not too small.
Chu Tiankuo sat in the car and watched her hawking. After not seeing her for a few days, she was damn thinner. Her pale face and the shadows under her big eyes made him feel distressed and angry.
He wanted to know how she had been living these days, so he suppressed his emotions, tried hard to suppress the urge to get out of the car to find her, and continued to sit in the car and wait for her silently.
As time passed, the number of people gradually became fewer and fewer, and finally even the MRT was stopped, but she still did not leave.
Twelve o'clock...one o'clock...two o'clock...
She was sitting on a small chair, and her shadow under the street lamp looked extremely thin and lonely.Zero zero.
When there were no guests, she couldn't bear the fatigue. Sometimes she would accidentally close her eyes and fall asleep, only to wake up suddenly after a few seconds, shake her head, and steel herself.
Then within a few minutes, he fell asleep again...
He couldn't bear it any longer. No matter if she didn't love him or if she actually liked another man, there was no way he could leave her alone.
He got out of the car, closed the door, and strode towards her.
Before he could get close to her, several men suddenly came out of the KTV and approached her stall and surrounded her, making her look uneasy.
"Miss, you don't have to sell braised food here anymore! Come sing with us, how about we give you two thousand yuan? It's easier to make money than selling braised food, right?"
"No! Go away!"
A man grabbed her hand. She was trembling with fear and struggled desperately, but she couldn't break free from the man's hand. She was so anxious that she almost cried.
The sky is vast! Save me!
At this time, this name was the only thing that came to her mind, but she immediately thought that she could no longer rely on him.
He has nothing to do with her anymore.
"Go away! You bad guys!"
The high-pitched screams had no effect in the middle of the night and only served to increase the men's ridicule.
She was anxious and angry, and struggled harder, but suddenly, the pressure on her hands disappeared, and the man who was holding her just now fell to the ground for some reason.
Bang, bang! The sound of flesh being struck by fists sounded extremely bloody.
She was dumbfounded as she watched Chu Tiankuo, who didn't know when he appeared, knock him to the ground.
"Get out!" He roared in a low and terrifying voice.
The men looked at the tall and strong man with fearful eyes, picked up their injured companion, and turned around to escape in embarrassment.
Qiao Ruoxi didn't know how to react until Chu Tiankuo grabbed her hand.
"Go back with me!"
"No, don't!" She came back to her senses and tried to hide back.
He frowned as he didn't expect her to refuse. "What did you say?"
She refused to look at him and turned her head. "Don't worry about me, I still have business to do."
"What business are you doing? What time is it now? Do you know that it's dangerous for a girl like you here?" He was furious. He was going crazy when he thought about how long she had lived like this and how many times she had been in danger.
"It's none of your business." She said these words stubbornly.
"What?"
"What I do is none of your business." Qiao Ruoxi finally turned to look directly at him and said bitterly: "I am no longer your girlfriend. Didn't you make this very clear? You were kind enough to introduce me to others, weren't you?"
He was stunned and angry, but unable to refute. When did she become so talkative? When did the docile little rabbit start biting?
Either she's changed, or she's really pissed off. And there was resentment in her eyes when she looked at him that he couldn't bear.
"Please go away." She shook off his hand and returned to her stall.
Chu Tiankuo stood dumbly, at a loss for the first time and not knowing what to do.
He finally saw how persistent she could be when she was stubborn. It's already the fifth day. She comes to set up a stall every night, and he has been following her in the car silently, waiting for her on the street corner.
Late at night, the dark circles under her eyes were deeper than in the past few days, she took naps more frequently, and the thin cheeks of her small face were now sunken.
His gloomy eyes were locked on her, and her body wouldn't be able to hold on like this. He was anxious and irritable, but he couldn't do anything.
Because she used his words to silence him. He is the one who wants to break up, and he no longer has the right to control her.
Damn it! Why is she so stubborn? He couldn't understand her motivation for insisting on making money to pay him back. He said she didn't need to pay it back, but she didn't listen.
Her business was not very good tonight, probably because it was drizzling and there were not many people on the street.
She doesn'tAfter falling asleep from exhaustion for the first time, he looked at his watch and sighed, then started to pack up the stall.
Chu Tiankuo breathed a sigh of relief. She decided to go home, well, it was an hour earlier than usual today.
Whenever he saw her struggling to pick up the heavy incubator, he wanted to rush out of the car to help her. But that would only get her rejection and glare. He had tried to help several times before, but she refused to accept any help from him at all. Damn woman!
She pushed the cart and headed home. The rain hit her, and she was not wearing a raincoat, so she got wet all of a sudden. In addition, there were not many things sold today, and the car was heavier. Her body was swaying, as if she could no longer bear the weight.
